definitions.line: T31 D4 wall_profile: base-x through GT crate centre (x, y), z = crate centre z + 4 mm, +-150 mm, 0.5 mm samples; width = 0.5 mm x number of samples with EsdfField.distance (trilinear) < 0.
definitions.gt_on_line: two walls crossed: crate_wall_nx and crate_wall_px, each 8 mm thick (scene_transport.xml size 0.004 half-thickness, collision and visual geoms both) -> 16 mm solid on the line. nx/px widths = s < 0 / s >= 0 (crate centre split).
definitions.tsdf_lt0: cuRobo TSDF (sdf_sum / weight, weight > minimum_tsdf_weight) of the TSDF voxel containing each line sample (h4_common.tsdf_at) < 0.
definitions.server_settings: --voxel 0.020 --fine-voxel 0.005 --tsdf-voxel 0.005, attached_sign_threshold_voxels 1.5, esdf.truncation_voxels default 3.0; EsdfConfig.truncation = truncation_voxels x voxel_size (ag3s/config.py:867-868) -> MapperCfg.truncation_distance 0.060 m (curobo_builder.py:173); MapperCfg defaults seeding_method gather, minimum_tsdf_weight 0.1.
definitions.cuRobo_sign: compute_esdf_from_min_tsdf_kernel (builder_esdf.py): |d| = EDT distance to nearest seed; d negative iff TSDF at the ESDF voxel centre < 0. Seeds: |tsdf| <= 0.9 x tsdf_voxel or tsdf < -(truncation - 1.1 x tsdf_voxel) (gather: 7 probes at centre and +-half ESDF voxel).
definitions.tsdf_integration: builder_camera_integrate.py:540-551: sdf = depth - z_cam, integrated when sdf >= -truncation, clamped at +truncation, weighted running sum.
definitions.real_input: E3b_ep1807_r1 re-rendered depth (TransportScene.attach 480x640, planning-row qpos of seq 1..k+1, uint16 mm), robot mask = GT segmentation of robot bodies (server used the sphere self-filter), attached points = T31diag D3 reconstruction, fine window centre from recorded esdf_origin.
definitions.synthetic_input: analytic ray cast of a box wall (thickness 16 or 8 mm, at GT crate_wall_px position) + table slab; zed_left K; views head_1side (zed_left pose at seq 31), head_2side (+ mirror through wall mid-plane), normal_1side / normal_2side (optical axis along wall normal, same distance); same frame integrated 31 times unless stated.
